SELECT /* getScheduleLogList */
FROM ( SELECT R.RUNX_NUMB , R.SCHD_CODE , R.SCHD_CODE_NAME , R.METH_NAME , R.EXEC_STAT , R.STRT_DATE , R.FNSH_DATE , R.TRGT_CNTT , R.SUCC_CNTT , R.FAIL_CNTT , R.EXEC_MSEC , ROWNUM AS ROW_NUMB FROM ( SELECT FROM TL_SCLOGX S ORDER BY S.RUNX_NUMB DESC ) R WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) P WHERE P.ROW_NUMB >= #{startRow}
SELECT /* getScheduleFailList */ RUNX_NUMB , FAIL_NUMB , FAIL_TYPE , RSLT_CODE , RSLT_MESG , ERRO_TYPE , ERRO_CNTN , FAIL_DATE FROM TL_SCFAIL WHERE RUNX_NUMB = #{runxNumb} ORDER BY FAIL_NUMB
